lead_raw_text:
The structure of Lu2Mg18Fe2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/nmc (No. 143), with 22 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Fe, Lu, and Mg centers in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom; neighbor distances range from about 3.07 to 3.36 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing relations, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
